gloss: high-class shop; upscale restaurant; luxury establishment

definitions.gloss: upscale shop or restaurant; luxury establishment
definitions.explanation: A shop, restaurant, or other establishment of high quality and price, catering to wealthy customers. Covers both food and retail contexts.

examples.japanese: {高級店|こうきゅうてん}でディナーを{食|た}べた。
examples.english: I had dinner at an upscale restaurant.

examples.japanese: {銀座|ぎんざ}には{高級店|こうきゅうてん}が{立|た}ち{並|なら}んでいる。
examples.english: Upscale shops line the streets of Ginza.

examples.japanese: {高級店|こうきゅうてん}とはいえ、サービスに{見合|みあ}う{価値|かち}があるかどうかは{別問題|べつもんだい}だ。
examples.english: Even if it is an upscale establishment, whether it offers value for the service is a separate question.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- {高級|こうきゅう}レストラン: high-end restaurant (more specific to dining)
- {老舗|しにせ}: long-established shop — emphasizes history and tradition rather than price or luxury
- デパート: department store — may contain high-end sections but is not itself a 高級店

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高級店|こうきゅうてん}に{行|い}く: to go to an upscale establishment
- {高級|こうきゅう}{和食店|わしょくてん}: high-end Japanese restaurant
- {高級|こうきゅう}ブランド{店|てん}: luxury brand store
